requestedActions.title: List active task titles for the connected Todoist account, with pagination

guide.summary: Customers can connect through a third-party OAuth app: you register an app, redirect users to the authorization URL with a scope parameter, and exchange the returned code for an access token. The read action maps to the documented read-only data:read scope, which also grants read access to projects, labels and filters, not only tasks. Active task listing uses GET /api/v1/tasks, which is cursor-paginated until next_cursor is null. Write scopes (task:add, data:read_write, data:delete) must not be requested. Provider review and distribution requirements are not in the supplied sources and remain unknown.

findings.title: Request data:read for read-only task listing
findings.detail: data:read grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels and filters. It is the documented read-only grant covering active task titles, so it is the least-privilege scope for this action.
findings.appliesWhen: For the read-only active task listing action

evidence.quote: data:read Grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters.
data:read_write Grants read and write access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters. This scope includes task:add and data:read scopes.

findings.title: Do not request write or delete scopes
findings.detail: task:add, data:read_write and data:delete grant task creation, modification or deletion. None is needed for this read-only use case, so they must not be requested.
findings.appliesWhen: Always, given the read-only and no-write prohibitions

data:delete Grants permission to delete application data, including tasks, labels, and filters.

steps.title: Test the first page of active tasks with the OAuth token
steps.detail: Call GET /api/v1/tasks with only the OAuth bearer token from the test account. Representative input: a connected test account that has at least one active task. Map the content property of each object in results to a task title. Expected result: HTTP 200 with a results array and a next_cursor value. Boundary check: confirm the request is a GET only, uses the OAuth bearer token, requests only the data:read scope, and calls no write endpoint such as create, update, complete or delete.
steps.doneWhen: The first page returns HTTP 200 with a results array and next_cursor, and the granted OAuth scope is confirmed as data:read only.

steps.title: Test cursor pagination until next_cursor is null
steps.detail: Repeat GET /api/v1/tasks with cursor set to the next_cursor value from the previous response, and send no other parameters so every paginated request uses the same parameter set. Collect the content property of each results item on every page. Stop only when next_cursor is null, which is the documented end of results. Representative input: the next_cursor value returned by the first page. Expected result: all pages are collected until next_cursor is null. Boundary check: confirm every request is a GET with the same parameters and that no write endpoint is called.
steps.doneWhen: Requests continue with cursor until next_cursor is null, and the number of collected titles matches the total returned across all pages.
